system.description:
As a requirement to activate this jutsu, you must currently be in the Lion Fist Stance.

You enter a prideful stance showing your overwhelming superiority and power.

Make two melee taijutsu attacks. On a hit you deal your [Unarmed damage] + 1d6. If your targets have ranks of Shaken, increase this Jutsu's damage by +1 damage die.

Finisher: you instead deal your [Unarmed damage] + 3d6 and if you score two hits on the target, they must make a Wisdom saving throw, gaining +1 rank of Shaken on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can increase the number of attacks by +1.
